h1: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 52 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 52 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a comprehensive project for a 52 m² apartment, covering interior design and technical documentation, custom furniture, turnkey renovation and final decoration.

The design covers the main functional areas of the apartment: living room, bedroom, kitchen with individually planned storage and built-in appliances, dressing areas, entrance hall and bathroom. Custom wardrobes, shelving and storage systems were also integrated into the project.

Custom furniture solutions were developed for the individual areas based on the dimensions of the space, ergonomics and everyday requirements. Designing the furniture together with the interior makes it possible to use the available floor area efficiently while maintaining a consistent visual concept throughout the apartment.

Before implementation, a detailed project estimate was prepared covering renovation works, finishing materials, custom furniture and household appliances. This approach provides a clearer understanding of the overall implementation budget before the work begins.
The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations, demonstrating the layout, interior concept and custom furniture solutions developed for the 52 m² apartment.
